cross_cutting.reporting_only: This report does not assign admission (CANDIDATE / SHADOW_TEST / LIMITED_DEPLOYMENT). It records the harness statuses computed from the frozen criteria for the Lead's decision.

C6.reason: the forward registry has no resolved forecasts for either pair; C6 cannot be satisfied on the first day of the registry

C4.T1_W1: INCONCLUSIVE (fewer than 12 recession origins in W1, protocol C4 minimum)
C4.T1_W2: PASS or FAIL per candidate/loss (reported in the candidate tables)
C4.T2: INCONCLUSIVE in both windows: the runner's recession mask for T2 h=0 uses usrec_event(origin, horizon=0), which contains no months and is therefore identically zero; this is a harness-runner limitation (not a candidate result), recorded for the Lead and NOT fixed here (tools/ is out of scope)
C4.note: C4 never counts as passed for a candidate unless every window/loss passes; INCONCLUSIVE is not a pass

availability.rule: SPF median at the survey deadline month (middle month of the quarter, month-end origin, +14 days after the survey anchor); no SPF at other origins

SPF.role: third-party point forecast; its predictive distribution in the ensemble is the project's own derived statistic (empirical SPF forecast errors centred on the current median)
SPF.comparator: the frozen primary comparator does NOT contain SPF (SPF_MEDIAN is not a comparator member by protocol), so the T2 h=0 comparison is not apples-to-apples: the candidate may use an OPEN external source that the comparator excludes
SPF.mapping_caveat: the drgdp2..6 -> T2 horizon mapping is declared by the project and still requires confirmation against the official SPF documentation (docs/71 section 3.3, docs/81 section 4); the T2 results are therefore preliminary and conditional on that mapping
SPF.values_policy: SPF values stay in git-ignored data/raw/spf; only derived ensemble statistics are recorded, with attribution to the Philadelphia Fed

comparison_to_previous.T1_CPI_YOY_h1: reproduced exactly on the same 121/156 REAL_TIME origins: the relative losses RMSE/CRPS (1.000750/1.000704 on W1, 1.000399/1.000778 on W2) and the CANDIDATE status are identical to docs/76, which validates the evaluation pipeline and the origin filter
comparison_to_previous.T2_GDP_GROWTH_h0: ENSEMBLE_RW_AR is NOT evaluable on T2: its member RW has no T2 model (RW applies to T1 only), so every origin fails and the candidate produces zero forecasts; it was skipped. The registration of ENSEMBLE_RW_AR for T2 is inconsistent with the R3 model set and should be corrected by the Lead

structural_finding.C1: ENSEMBLE_EQUAL is mechanically identical to the primary comparator (same members, equal weights, same mixture CDF), so its relative loss is exactly 1.0; no ensemble of comparator members can reach the C1 threshold of 0.97 without additional information. INVERSE_MSE/BAYES/ADAPTIVE improve on the comparator only by 0.02-0.23% (T1) and 0.0004-0.14% (T2 RMSE), far above the threshold
structural_finding.statistical_significance: the tiny improvements are nevertheless statistically detectable by the DM/C2 test at long samples (raw p=0.0 for several candidates), which illustrates that a frozen C1 relative-loss threshold, not the DM test, is the binding gate

limitations: T1 calibration history for the first ~12 origins of W1 can contain member forecasts computed in PSEUDO_REAL_TIME mode for models that need the yield-curve inputs (BVAR), because GS10/TB3MS vintages start 1996-12; current-origin forecasts are REAL_TIME, but the ADAPTIVE/BAYES/INVERSE weights of those first origins rest on a partly pseudo history. This is a property of the registered candidate implementation (mode=auto) and is reported, not changed (src/amfe/ensemble is registered code)
T2 h=0 C4 is degenerate in the harness runner (zero recession mask), so C4 is INCONCLUSIVE by construction
SPF values are third-party data; they are not committed and only derived statistics appear here; the T2 SPF-inclusive comparison requires the mapping decision
C6 absent: no forward-registry forecasts are resolved yet; the maximum possible stage on the first day is CANDIDATE

runtimes are dominated by the dense-vintage DataContext construction per member/origin: 769.5 s for T1 (5 candidates) and 746.1 s for T2 (4 candidates); this is a speed limitation, not a correctness issue
